description: This file defines a custom exception class `SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError` used within the Twig templating engine's sandbox security mechanism. It represents an error thrown when an unauthorized property access occurs in a template.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError
classes.description: An exception class indicating an unauthorized property access in Twig's sandbox security context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message, class name, and property name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class where the unauthorized property access was attempted.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property that access was attempted on.
